why: The app text is right: it is the Wahapedia Knight Defender’s Conversion line, attributed to its weapon. That is a label, not an interpretation, and GW’s Core Rules and Rules Updates have no Conversion definition. But the reason misnames its evidence. The same “Knight Castellan/Valiant: 24"” slip is in the data.js comment above RULES 'Conversion'. Fix the reason in verify/deviations-texts.json, and that comment the same way.

fix.app: **Conversion beam obliterator** (Knight Defender): Each time an attack is made with this weapon, if the target is more than 18" away from the bearer, an unmodified successful **Hit roll** of 4+ scores a Critical Hit.
fix.reason: [CONVERSION] has no core-rules or glossary definition (GW's Core Rules, the Universal Rules Updates and Wahapedia's core rules have none): GW's datasheets define it per weapon, each with its own range (the Faction Pack's Armiger Moirax conversion beam cannon: "more than 12" from the bearer"; its Acastus Knight Asterius twin conversion beam cannon: "more than 24" from the bearer"). So the glossary entry gives each weapon's own words, named by the weapon ("Conversion beam obliterator (Knight Defender):", the app's label); the lists have one such weapon. GW's Faction Pack does not reprint the Knight Defender datasheet; the Wahapedia Knight Defender datasheet (the codex) is the only source of these words, which texts.js does not search for glossary entries.
fix.data.js comment: // with that weapon's range (the Faction Pack's Armiger Moirax: 12", Acastus Knight Asterius: 24"), so each weapon's own words, named
